cards.name: Pixie Bot

effects.printed_clause: If you Link Summoned a monster this turn using a Normal Monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand to your zone a Link Monster points to.
effects.lua_implementation: A duel-global EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS check inspects Link material groups for TYPE_NORMAL and flags the Summon player through PHASE_END; e1 computes all Link-pointed own Main Monster Zones and Special Summons into the chosen zone.

official_references.official_effect_text:
2 Effect Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned using a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster as material: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 card on the field or in either GY; [b]banish[/b] it, [b]also[/b] your monsters [b]cannot[/b] attack directly this turn. [b]When[/b] your opponent activates a card or effect ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 2 face-up monsters on the field, including a monster you control; [b]banish[/b] both until the [b]End Phase[/b]. [b]You can[/b] only use each effect of "S:P Little Knight" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of "Parallel eXceed", its Level becomes 4 [b]and[/b] its original ATK/DEF become halved. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Parallel eXceed" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
● If you Link Summon: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon this card from your hand to your zone that Link Monster points to.
● If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon 1 "Parallel eXceed" from your Deck.

effects.printed_clause: You can banish 1 Link Monster from your GY; Special Summon Normal Monsters from your GY up to the Link-Rating of the banished monster.
effects.lua_implementation: e2 banishes an eligible Link as cost while storing its Link Rating, then summons 1..min(rating,free zones) Normal Monsters from GY.

official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is sent to the GY: [b]Banish[/b] 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT or DARK Dragon monster from your Deck. If this card is banished from your GY: [b]You can[/b] add the monster banished by this card's effect to your hand.
Special Summon from your GY as many FIRE monsters as possible with 200 DEF, but [b]banish[/b] them during the [b]End Phase[/b] of this turn.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of "Pixie Bot" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: e1/e2 use distinct hard id/id+100 codes.

official_references.official_effect_text: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
